question: Can ANY publicly-accessible WebArena deployment path (Docker Hub WebArena-Verified images, ZIM+Kiwix Wikipedia, or ghcr.io with auth) provide a live DOM surface for measuring actual fragment yield, thereby resolving whether heuristic yield estimates (0.517-0.65) are calibrated?
hypothesis: At least one of 3 deployment paths is viable in the current environment: (A) Docker Hub am1n3e/webarena-verified-* images on linux/amd64, (B) ZIM+Kiwix local Wikipedia server with Playwright, (C) ghcr.io/web-arena-x with GITHUB_TOKEN/PAT. If any path deploys successfully, actual measured yield with geometry-faithful viewport filtering will be within 15pp of the heuristic estimate for that site type.
falsifier: If ALL 3 deployment paths fail (Docker Hub images unavailable on amd64, ZIM+Kiwix cannot serve WebArena-compatible pages, ghcr.io auth unavailable), verdict = BLOCKED. If a path succeeds but actual yield deviates >15pp from heuristic, verdict = FALSIFIES (heuristic model not calibrated). If the pipeline cannot produce a valid yield measurement from any deployed surface, verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
baselines: Heuristic yield estimates from EXP-INTEL-33945226776: shopping 0.65, reddit 0.65, gitlab 0.60, shopping_admin 0.60, map 0.598, wikipedia 0.517 (unvalidated priors)
Method 1 (element-count) estimates: shopping 0.365, reddit 0.45, shopping_admin 0.468, gitlab 0.484, wikipedia 0.517, map 0.598 (modeling viewport coverage 0.45-0.65 and node pruning 0.06-0.15)
Truncation sensitivity ratios from parent: shopping 0.37, reddit 0.439, gitlab 0.471, shopping_admin 0.453, map 0.702, wikipedia 0.897 (max_obs_length=1920 binding constraint)
WebArena-Verified HuggingFace dataset (AmineHA/WebArena-Verified): 812 tasks with metadata, sites, intents, eval specs — available for structural analysis independent of Docker deployment
positive_control: If ANY deployment path succeeds and serves a page with interactive DOM elements, the observation pipeline (Playwright accessibility tree extraction + viewport filtering + pruning + truncation) must produce a non-empty observation. This verifies the pipeline can extract structured observations from a live web surface.
null_control: If Docker Hub images are attempted, at least one image must be pullable on linux/amd64 within the environment's disk/memory constraints (86GB disk, 15GB RAM). If no image is pullable, this is an infrastructure finding, not a scientific null.
measurement_validity: Step 1 (INFRASTRUCTURE CENSUS): Systematically test all deployment paths in order of lowest-to-highest cost: (A) Docker Hub am1n3e/* images with --platform linux/amd64, (B) ZIM+Kiwix Wikipedia with Kiwix ZIM file download, (C) ghcr.io/web-arena-x with GITHUB_TOKEN/PAT. Record exact status of each attempt.

Step 2 (DATASET ANALYSIS): Load WebArena-Verified tasks from HuggingFace (AmineHA/WebArena-Verified). Analyze task metadata: site type distribution, multi-site tasks, intent complexity, eval evaluator types. This analysis is independent of Docker deployment and provides structural intelligence about the corpus.
Step 3 (DEPLOYMENT): For each viable path from Step 1, deploy the environment and verify it serves HTTP content. Record ports, URLs, response codes.

Step 4 (MEASUREMENT): For each deployed environment, select 1 task, launch Playwright headless Chromium (viewport 1280x720), navigate to starting URL, extract accessibility tree via CDP, apply geometry-faithful viewport filtering (union_bound/bounding-box intersection, NOT depth/role heuristic), apply IGNORED_ACTREE_PROPERTIES pruning, truncate at UTTERANCE_MAX_LENGTH=8192 and max_obs_length=1920.
Step 5 (CALCULATION): Compute fragment yield = elements_surviving_pipeline / total_elements_in_observation. Compare to heuristic baseline. Compute yield_delta = |actual_yield - heuristic_yield|.
N=1 per viable deployment path (pilot calibration). Minimum 1 path must succeed before yield measurement.

Viewport filtering MUST use geometry-faithful implementation. If CDP union_bound is not directly accessible, use Playwright locator.bounding_box() intersection with viewport rect. If neither is achievable, label measurement as 'pilot with viewport heuristic approximation' and quantify error bound.
Raw accessibility tree artifacts must be saved with durable sha256 hashes.
decision_rule: IF at least 1 deployment path succeeds AND actual yield is within 15pp of heuristic yield for that site type, verdict = SUPPORTS (heuristic model is calibrated for that site type). IF at least 1 path succeeds AND actual yield deviates >15pp, verdict = FALSIFIES (heuristic model not calibrated). IF ALL deployment paths fail (no environment can be deployed), verdict = BLOCKED. IF a path deploys but the pipeline cannot produce valid yield measurement, verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
product_consequence_positive: Validates at least one deployment path for WebArena environments. If yield is calibrated within 15pp, Graph lane can proceed with C-CROSSSITE/C-LLM-INHERIT testing using the812-task corpus. If ZIM+Kiwix works for Wikipedia, this provides a lightweight, auth-free path for Wikipedia tasks.
product_consequence_negative: If all deployment paths fail, the 812-task corpus cannot be used for live measurement in this environment. Intel should reassess whether VisualWebArena, Mind2Web, or other benchmarks offer a lower-uncertainty path. If yield is not calibrated, heuristic priors are unreliable and corpus suitability is unknown.
estimated_cost: Medium: Docker Hub image pulls (5-10GB per site type, may timeout), ZIM file download (~310MB for 100-article Wikipedia), Playwright execution. ~2-4 hours of infrastructure exploration + 30 minutes of measurement per viable path. Previous attempts found Playwright/Chromium OK, Docker daemon OK, 86GB disk / 15GB RAM available.
expected_information_gain: HIGH: This is the third attempt to resolve the central unknown from EXP-INTEL-33945226776. Unlike prior attempts that only tested ghcr.io, this experiment systematically tests ALL available deployment paths (Docker Hub, ZIM+Kiwix, ghcr.io). A positive result unblocks C-CROSSSITE. A BLOCKED result with a complete infrastructure census enables the next agent to make an informed decision about alternative benchmarks. Even partial results (e.g., ZIM+Kiwix works but Docker Hub does not) are informative.
